q: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer LIMIT 100

q: How many tracks are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Track LIMIT 100

q: How many customers are from Brazil?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS BrazilCustomerCount FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil' LIMIT 100

q: What is the average invoice total?
sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS AverageTotal FROM Invoice LIMIT 100

q: What is the longest track by duration?
sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which country has the most customers?
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1

q: Total sales per year
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, SUM(Total) AS TotalSales FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year LIMIT 100

q: Top 5 customers by total spend
sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpend FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpend DESC LIMIT 5

q: Top 5 billing countries by total revenue
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 5

q: How many tracks are there in each genre?
sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre AS g LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY g.Name LIMIT 100

q: Which media type is used by the most tracks?
sql: SELECT mt.Name FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which artist has the most albums?
sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which genre generates the most revenue?
sql: SELECT Genre.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 1

q: Top 10 artists by revenue
sql: SELECT Artist.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10

q: Which sales support agent has the most customers?
sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many employees report to Nancy Edwards?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee AS e JOIN Employee AS m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards' LIMIT 100

q: Monthly sales for 2023
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(Total) AS MonthlySales FROM Invoice WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Month LIMIT 100

q: How many customers spent more than the average customer?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total_spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) AS cs WHERE total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total_spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)) LIMIT 100
